rejected.reason: Ford schedule sheet is for 'Variant 1.0L DURATEC/ECOBOOST/MAN (06/2012 - )', not the 1.25. Its 'Spark plugs Renew' and 'Induction air filter Renew (more often in polluted conditions)' at 'Interval 3 Years (37500 ml)' and 'Camshaft drive belt, tensioner and idlers Every 150 000 miles/10 years - Renew' / 'Auxiliary drive belts Every 150 000 miles/10 years - Renew' are 1.0-litre figures (also on the 1yr/2yr/4yr/5yr/8yr/10yr sheets) and must not be applied to the SNJB.

Page is titled 'Ford Fiesta Mk VI 2008-2012 Maintenance Plans' (model years 2008-2012). It carries the same '1.25 (Duratec) Petrol (SNJB)' Ford Technical Service plan (20,000 km/12 months; timing belt 'every 160,000 km/96 months'; brake fluid 'every 24 months'; air filter and spark plugs at 60,000 km/36 months) but the 2011-2019 page was used instead for model-year coverage.

Interval rows are for 'FORD FIESTA VI Van 1.25 (08/2008–12/2012)' ('12 Monate / 15000 km' to 2011/07, '12 Monate / 20000 km' from 2011/08; Zahnriemen 'alle 160.000 km / 8 Jahre') - van variant and 2008-2012 build dates, not a 2015 car.
Answer ('1.25/1.4/1.6-litre petrol: every 160,000km/8 years') is given for a 2012 Ford Fiesta, not 2015.
Article describes a 2008 Ford Fiesta 1.25 ('100,000 miles or 120 months'); different model year and no source cited.

Intervals stated are 'from a 2019 Ford Fiesta owner's manual' (service every 10,000 miles, spark plugs 100,000 miles, timing belt '1.0L & 1.6L engines' 150,000 miles) - different generation/model year.

notes: Strongest chain: Ford UK/FR official interval overviews put the Fiesta (10/2012-04.2017) on a 1-year / 12,500-mile (20,000 km) main service; Haynes' Ford-Technical-Service plan for engine code SNJB (Fiesta Mk VI 2011-2019 page) gives 20,000 km/12 months service with oil+filter every service, air filter and spark plugs every 60,000 km/36 months, timing belt every 160,000 km/96 months, brake fluid every 24 months; Haynes' 2013-2017 Mk7 guide adds pollen filter 12,500 miles/12 months, auxiliary belt 100,000 miles/8 years (1.25/1.6), coolant 10 years per Ford with Super Plus (Haynes: 2 years). No Ford Israel / Delek Motors schedule was found online; the Israeli cadence (15,000 km/12 months, from an Israeli price-comparison table) differs from Ford Europe's 20,000 km. The Ford 'Fiesta 2013' schedule sheets found are for the 1.0L variant and are flagged accordingly. Haynes engine tables use ●/○ dots per interval column, so item intervals there are derived from column headers rather than a sentence.
